_说明: 请求头与 Cookie 配置文件。本文件被 download_images_zh.py / download_images_en.py 自动读取。
_description_en: Headers and cookies configuration. Auto-loaded by download_images_zh.py / download_images_en.py.
_用法: 1. headers: 对所有请求生效的通用请求头（User-Agent 默认已设置，可在此覆盖）
2. cookies: 对所有请求生效的 Cookie，格式为 'key1=val1; key2=val2'
3. per_host: 按域名定制请求头和 Cookie，会覆盖通用设置（如新浪图床的 Referer）
4. 字段均可留空，不影响程序运行
5. 修改本文件后无需重启，下次下载时自动重新读取
_usage_en: 1. headers: common request headers applied to all requests (User-Agent is set by default; override here)
2. cookies: common cookie string applied to all requests, format: 'key1=val1; key2=val2'
3. per_host: per-host headers and cookies, override the common settings (e.g. Referer for Sina image bed)
4. All fields can be left empty; the program still runs
5. No restart needed after editing; the config is re-read on the next download
